newsitem.title: CHINA: New World to spin off service businesses.
newsitem.headline: New World to spin off service businesses.

text.p: New World Development Co Ltd said on Monday it planned to seek a separate listing on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong of its interests in certain service businesses to be held under New World Services Ltd (NWS).

NWS would hold New World's interests in the businesses of operation and management of convention and exhibition centres, construction, electrical and mechanical engineering, property and facility mangement, security and guarding and other services, it said in a statement.
New World is expected to hold about 72 percent of NWS's total issued share capital, valued at about HK$4.03 billion, after its proposed reorganisation, which was announced earlier this month.
HSBC Investment Bank Asia Ltd and Tai Fook Capital Ltd have been appointed to advise New World and NWS, respectively, in connection with the proposed separate listing, the company said.
"It is expected that an advance booking form in connection with the proposed separate listing will be submitted to and be considered by the stock exchange in due course," New World said.

The company also said that a decision on whether or not the listing would take place would depend on a number of factors. It said it was premature to speculate as to when and on what terms this might happen.
Further announcements relating to the proposed separate listings would be made as and when appropriate, it added.
